messages:
incident-bot: ALERT -> P99 latency breach for customer LodeCore (eu-central). Dedicated pool: lodecore-eu-central. Metrics: p95=1.2s p99=5.4s. Impact: UI timeouts reported. Paging on-call SRE. https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/lodecore?orgId=1 :rotating_light:

alice: oncall here, ack. pulling top traces and pool metrics now. tagging @carla for runtime helpers.

ben: I'm nearby, will stand up tracing query if needed. do we have noisy tenant suspicion? last 30m shows bursty seq len and KV miss rate spike.

carla: runtime saw sustained KV cache miss rate + heavy decode loops. suspect tenant-42 and tenant-83 sent large batch requests at 10:12-10:28.

alice: copying logs snippet:```
[10:15:23] pool=lodecore-eu-central req=tenant-42 seq=4096 tokens=1500 latency=3.8s
[10:17:02] pool=lodecore-eu-central req=tenant-83 seq=8192 tokens=3200 latency=6.1s
[10:18:45] pool=lodecore-eu-central kv_cache_miss=0.82
```

derek: LodeCore account owner here. Customer is reporting slow dashboards and failed batch jobs. They've escalated internally. Please keep me posted on mitigation and ETA.

eva: support pinged customer with initial notice and mitigation plan. Customer asked for root cause and whether we can isolate their traffic.

alice: immediate plan: 1) isolate noisy tenants (evict if necessary), 2) enable temporary per-tenant rate limit, 3) scale up pool by +2 GPUs as safe fallback, 4) enable cross-region failover if sustained >10m. Doing steps 1-3 now.

carla: preparing eviction command. recommended order: throttle -> evict -> scale.

alice: running throttle for tenant-42 and tenant-83:```
redwoodctl tenant throttle --tenant tenant-42 --pool lodecore-eu-central --qps 5 --reason "mitigation p99"
redwoodctl tenant throttle --tenant tenant-83 --pool lodecore-eu-central --qps 3 --reason "mitigation p99"
```

deploy-bot: THROTTLE_APPLIED -> tenant-42, tenant-83 on lodecore-eu-central (initiated by alice).

ben: seeing immediate p99 drop from 5.4s -> 2.1s after throttle. good signal. starting eviction for tenant-83 if values don't improve in 2m.

alice: eviction run (manual):```
redwoodctl pool evict --pool lodecore-eu-central --tenant tenant-83 --reason "KV storm causing p99 breach" --dry-run=false
# API fallback
curl -X POST "https://ops.redwood.internal/api/v1/pools/lodecore-eu-central/evict" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"tenant":"tenant-83","reason":"p99 mitigation"}'
```

carla: eviction successful, tenant-83 connections terminated, background reclaim started.

alice: scaling pool +2 GPUs:```
redwoodctl pool scale --pool lodecore-eu-central --add 2 --reason "short-term p99 mitigation"
```

deploy-bot: POOL_SCALE_STARTED -> lodecore-eu-central +2 gpus (requested by alice). ETA ~3m.

ben: metrics update: p95 steady ~0.9s, p99 trending 1.3s down from 5.4s. KV cache miss dropped to 0.15. Looks like eviction + throttle helped.

derek: relaying to customer: "We've throttled a small number of noisy workloads and temporarily increased pool capacity. We're monitoring and will follow up with root cause and next steps." They asked about traffic routed to another region — can we failover safely?

carla: cross-region failover possible but requires routing policy change and customer consent for data locality. We should avoid unless it's sustained >15m.

alice: summarizing actions performed: throttled tenant-42/83, evicted tenant-83, scaled pool +2, increased cache warmth. Monitoring for 15m.

eva: customer confirmed reduced errors on their side after our message. they're asking for ETA on reclaim and whether tenant-83 will be blocked permanently.

carla: eviction will auto-reauth in 30m unless we put a block. recommend manual follow-up with customer ops to decide block window.

ben: preparing a post-incident action: add an anomaly-based auto-throttle rule when per-tenant seq-length > 2000 tokens/req or kv_miss > 0.6 for >2m. filing ticket.

alice: handing off to ben for the 20:00-22:00 watch window. ben, you own continuing monitor and the customer update cadence. I'll update the incident doc and create RCA stub.

ben: taking over. I'll run a 30m trace sampling and ensure no re-infestation. ping me if p99 > 2s again.

derek: thanks team. Customer wants a brief postmortem and whether we can add per-tenant soft-limits to prevent recurrence. Assign owners for PM request.

alice: assigned on ops ticket #INC-12741 -> owner: carla for runtime controls, ben for alert tuning, eva for customer comms.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE -> p99 returned to 0.95s, p95=0.87s. Pool lodecore-eu-central scaled +2 GPUs still active. No request for region failover. War room will stand down after 30m of stable metrics.

derek: leaving note for customer: "We'll follow up with RCA and proposed soft-limits. Thank you for patience."

ben: metrics stable for 32m now, p99 <= 1.0s. I'm closing the active mitigation actions: removed temporary throttle on tenant-42 (tenant-83 remains blocked until ops syncs with customer).

alice: incident doc updated, will sync with security and account teams for postmortem next week. Closing war room now. :white_check_mark:
